evals.prompt: Update plan/feature-rate-limiting-1.md in billing-api: product now wants per-tenant limits in addition to per-IP limits, and the Redis counters must expire after 24 hours.
evals.expected_output: The same plan file rewritten with new requirements, new tasks under the right phase, and refreshed front matter.
expectations: The file plan/feature-rate-limiting-1.md is modified in place and no second plan file is created
Section 1 gains new REQ-NNN or CON-NNN entries for per-tenant limits and the 24 hour expiry
New TASK-NNN rows are added with identifiers that do not collide with existing ones
The front matter last_updated field is set to the current date
All eight numbered section headings from the template are still present

evals.prompt: Update the implementation plan with the new login requirements.
evals.expected_output: The agent asks which plan file to update, or lists the candidates under plan/, before editing anything.
expectations: No file under plan/ is modified before the target plan file is identified
The transcript asks the user for the plan file path or lists the files under plan/ and asks which one to use
The transcript asks for or restates the new login requirements before editing

evals.prompt: Update plan/upgrade-node-runtime-1.md for web-app. Phase 2 is finished as of today and phase 3 is cancelled because the services it covered were deleted. Mark the plan status accordingly.
evals.expected_output: The plan file updated with phase 2 tasks marked complete and dated, phase 3 removed or marked as not applicable, and the status badge and front matter changed.
expectations: Every TASK-NNN row in phase 2 has the Completed column filled and a Date value
Phase 3 is either removed or every task row states it is cancelled, and the dependencies section no longer refers to deleted services
The front matter status and the img.shields.io badge in the introduction show the same value
No TASK-NNN identifier is declared twice after the edit
